notablePrerequisites:
Clever Impersonator on the battlefield as a copy of Forensic Researcher.
Forensic Researcher and Clever Impersonator do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Clever Impersonator.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Clever Impersonator.
Activate Clever Impersonator by tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Clever Impersonator ability, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Repeat.
